_note: r.164(3)(j) and (6)(m): "has agricultural income, exceeding ₹ 5000" — the limit is the bar's, W-090c's data; this row asks the amount. The engine does not bring agricultural income into the rates (W-258), so the amount serves the bar only. The question's wording is drafted by Claude, to be adopted by the owner; the clause is quoted from the Gazette. Valid for TY 2025-26 and TY 2026-27 (W-090d, D-652 G1a): for TY 2025-26 it is Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.12(1)(a) proviso (III) (Income-tax Rules, 1962, kept live by r.164(14)); the question names no section, so one wording serves both years.
question: How much agricultural income did you have in the tax year?
